DEFINITION: Definition A: Rate Collapse (FY25 SoW >= 25% -> FY26 SoW < 10%, Spend >= 5k)
JUSTIFICATION: Most statistically robust measure of payment displacement among active retail shoppers.

DEFINITION: Definition B: Hard Cessation (FY25 HSIC > 0 -> FY26 HSIC == 0, Active MetroMart)
JUSTIFICATION: Captures complete abandonment of co-brand card while customer remains actively retained by retailer.

DEFINITION: Definition C: High-Value Velocity Deceleration (Delta_SoW <= -20 pp, Spend >= 10k)
JUSTIFICATION: High-ticket focus; protects top decile revenue contributors.

DEFINITION: Definition D: Recency Gap (No HSIC in 2026, Active MetroMart in 2026)
JUSTIFICATION: Useful for immediate operational CRM contact triggers.
